proposal.summary: CHS pre-3.5.3 uses misconfigured ACLs on the local installation folder, allowing broad privileges to local users and potentially enabling system destruction or execution of malicious programs.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) prior to version 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: ACL (Access Control List) is not appropriately set to the local folder where the affected product is installed, therefore a wide range of privileges is permitted to a user of the PC where the affected product is installed.

AV.quote: ACL (Access Control List) is not appropriately set to the local folder where the affected product is installed, therefore a wide range of privileges is permitted to a user of the PC where the affected product is installed.

C.quote: a wide range of privileges is permitted to a user of the PC where the affected product is installed. As a result, the user may be able to destroy the system and/or execute a malicious program.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Review and correct ACL permissions on the installation directory, enforce least-privilege access for CHS services, and apply vendor-supplied patch to versions prior to 3.5.3; verify no remaining local-privilege escalation paths.
